title: Cap. II Sol. Arg. 6 close: not elect because foreseen faithful — foresight because electing makes them
pass_a_gloss: God therefore did not elect because he foresaw that they would be faithful, but they were foreseen as faithful because by electing them he makes them such.
pass_b_english: Bottom line: foresight of future faith is not why God elects. He foresaw them faithful because election itself is what makes them faithful.
source_text: Non ergo Deus elegit quia praevidit illos futuros fideles, sed praevisi sunt fideles quia eligendo eos tales facit.
